import re

def main():
    s = input().strip()
    res = 0
    if s and len(s) > 1:
        pattern = re.compile(r'(.)\1*')
        for m in pattern.finditer(s):
            if len(m.group()) % 2 == 0:
                res += 1
    print(res)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
